title: $64 million state loan for Lahaina water projects
summary: Bill 151 would authorize an agreement for a loan from the state Drinking Water State Revolving Fund. The money would pay for countywide wildfire disaster relief projects.

timeline.text: Bill 151 authorizes an agreement for a loan from the state Drinking Water State Revolving Fund for countywide wildfire disaster relief projects.
